# VoidPay (voidpay.xyz)

> VoidPay is crypto invoicing at voidpay.xyz where the invoice lives in the URL, with no backend storage.
> You fill in the invoice, share the link, and the payer connects a wallet and pays you directly on-chain.
> There is no account, no signup and no KYC. Invoice data is encoded in the URL hash fragment, which browsers never send to a server.

## Facts

- Free to use: no subscription and no transaction fees.
- Networks: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon; native tokens and ERC-20 tokens.
- Payment is peer-to-peer, from the payer's wallet to the address on the invoice. VoidPay never holds funds.
- Token decimals are fixed in the link when the invoice is created, and a payment is matched by its exact amount.
- Invoices export to PDF and carry a QR code.
- Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/ignromanov/voidpay
- Built by Ignat Romanov: https://lasipan.cc/
